name: matlodge-pcms
title: Matlodge PCM samples
description: Sample-level metadata for the phase-change materials collected for Matlodge. One row describes one sample, its source publication, and the available sample-preparation metadata. Optical properties (lambda, n and k) are stored separately as per-phase datasets.

resources.name: pcms
resources.title: PCM samples
resources.description: Sample metadata exported as a semicolon-delimited CSV file.

fields.name: material
fields.title: Material formulation
fields.description: Chemical formulation of the phase-change material, for example Sb2S3 or Ge2Sb2Te5.

fields.name: sample_id
fields.title: Sample identifier
fields.description: Identifier formed as <material>_<sample number>, for example Sb2S3_1.

fields.name: source_doi
fields.title: Source DOI
fields.description: DOI of the source publication as reported in the source data. Some values include a legacy dx.doi.org prefix.

fields.name: doi_link
fields.title: DOI link
fields.description: Resolvable link to the source publication.

fields.name: data_extraction_method
fields.title: Data extraction method
fields.description: Method used to import the data into Matlodge. This describes the provenance of the imported dataset rather than a property of the sample. The spelling 'digitalized' is kept as used in the source data.

fields.name: ri_measurement_method
fields.title: Refractive index measurement method
fields.description: Method used to measure the refractive index, for example ellipsometry or reflectance.

fields.name: source_model
fields.title: Ellipsometry fitting model
fields.description: Fitting or optical-constants model reported by the source, for example Tauc-Lorentz or Cody-Lorentz.

fields.name: source_model_has_parameters
fields.title: Fitting-model parameters available
fields.description: Whether the fitting-model parameters are available. The source values 'available' and the typo 'avialable' map to true; 'not specified' and the em dash are treated as missing.

fields.name: deposition_method
fields.title: Deposition method
fields.description: Method used to deposit the phase-change material film, for example RF sputtering or thermal evaporation.

fields.name: thickness
fields.title: PCM thickness
fields.description: Thickness as reported by the source, including its unit. Values may be ranges or contain more than one measurement, for example '100 nm', '600-750 nm' or '137 and 183 nm'.

fields.name: capping_layer
fields.title: Capping layer
fields.description: Capping layer as reported, for example '10 nm ITO' or '3 nm Al2O3'. The value 'none' means that the sample has no capping layer.
